name: brotli
description: a generic-purpose lossless compression algorithm that compresses data using a combination of a modern variant of the LZ77 algorithm, Huffman coding and 2nd order context modeling. (overlay: 1.2.1 rather than the baseline's 1.2.0, because CVE-2026-111497 is fixed there and Node.js v26's own brotli carries the same fix; plus Node.js's c/common/platform.h, which the registry build does not carry)
